issues.problem: narrative/chapter.md:428 一句话把两个不同的量都记成同一个符号/变量 q，并因此把机制讲错：“`torch.maximum(target_probs - draft_probs, 0)` 就是 max(0,p-q)；接着除以 q 再 argmax——这是 Gumbel-max 采样……argmax(prob/q) 就等价于从 norm(prob) 采样”。但追到源码，argmax 分母那个 q 变量（rejection_sampler.py:L1243 `q_values = q[token_to_batch]`）来自 sample_recovered_tokens() 里的 `q = torch.empty(...); q.exponential_()`（约L787-800）——它是每次调用现采的 i.i.d. Exponential(1) 噪声，跟本章第二节、以及同一段代码前两行 max(0, target_probs-draft_probs) 里的『q(x)=草稿模型概率』完全是两码事，只是恰好在源码里都叫 q。段落把随机噪声误当成草稿概率来解释，且描述的采样机制本身也和代码对不上：代码是『残差权重 / 独立 Exponential(1) 噪声 → argmax』（指数竞速/Gumbel-max 的除法变体），chapter 描述的却是『对数概率加 Gumbel(0,1) 噪声再 argmax』（加性 log-Gumbel 变体）——两者虽同分布但不是同一个算子，用后者的话术去解说前面贴出的代码是文不对题。附带的『祖先采样——从高维分布逐维向下递归采样』一句也用错了：这里只是单步类别采样，不涉及逐维递归。
issues.suggested_fix: 把这段改写为：明确指出 sample_recovered_tokens_pytorch 的形参 q（对应 rejection_sampler.py:L1243 的 q_values）不是草稿模型概率 q(x)，而是调用方 sample_recovered_tokens()（约L787-792，`q = torch.empty(...); q.exponential_()`）现采的 i.i.d. Exponential(1) 噪声，可考虑换个记号（如 ε 或直接叫『指数噪声』）避免与本章通篇的 q(x) 撞字母；机制描述改为『残差权重 max(0,p-q) 除以独立 Exponential(1) 噪声再 argmax，等价于类别采样（指数竞速/Gumbel-max 的除法变体：对 w_i、E_i~Exp(1) i.i.d.，argmax(w_i/E_i) ~ Categorical(w)）』，不要用『对数概率加 Gumbel(0,1) 噪声』这个加性变体来描述这几行代码；同时删去或改写『祖先采样』那句类比，因为这里不涉及逐维递归采样。
issues.rationale: 这直接触及本维度的铁律『符号一致、推导忠实』：章节通篇用 q 指代草稿模型概率分布 q(x)（接受准则、残差公式 p'=norm(max(0,p-q)) 都建立在这个符号上），落地节又把源码里恰好同名但语义完全不同的随机噪声变量也叫 q，导致『argmax(prob/q) 等价于从 norm(prob) 采样』这句话在 q 是草稿概率（确定性值）的语境下本身就是错的——对固定分母取 argmax 是确定性操作，不可能是‘采样’；只有 q 是随机噪声时这个论证才成立。读者对照源码会发现两处 q 对不上，机制解释站不住。

issues.problem: Algorithm 1 is referenced repeatedly but never shown in pseudocode form
issues.suggested_fix: Display Algorithm 1 pseudocode before §2.2, showing the accept-reject-resample loop over γ predictions
issues.rationale: The proof in §2 reads Algorithm 1 line-by-line (line 44: 'Algorithm 1 那行伪代码的每一步讲清楚'), but the algorithm is never displayed. Readers unfamiliar with speculative sampling must reverse-engineer it from context. Showing 4-5 lines of pseudocode would ground the entire proof.

issues.problem: Cost coefficient c = 0.05 appears in Table 2 without justification for where this value comes from
issues.suggested_fix: Add one sentence after line 266: 'In practice, c depends on hardware and model size; for modern GPUs, this ratio typically ranges 0.02–0.08 depending on compute/memory-bound regime'
issues.rationale: Readers can't assess whether 0.05 is realistic (hence whether the 3.092× speedup is achievable) or if it's just a toy value. This coefficient is critical to interpreting the final speedup numbers.

issues.problem: β appears in the first table (line 62) before being formally defined; definition only arrives 20 lines later at line 82
issues.suggested_fix: Move the β definition to just before §2.1, or add a preview: 'Let β = Σ_x min(p,q) denote single-step acceptance rate (proven ∈ [0,1])'
issues.rationale: The notation β is unexplained when readers first see it in the trace table, making that table harder to parse. Moving the definition forward keeps terminology order consistent.

issues.problem: Memory bandwidth bottleneck motivation is stated (line 24: 'not算力 but 在等着搬参数') but not explained mechanically
issues.suggested_fix: Add: 'Since one forward pass requires loading ~billions of parameters into the GPU, latency is dominated by data movement time (not compute). If a small model can make N guesses while those parameters are loading, the large model validates all N in parallel during the same memory stall—achieving N× speedup for free.'
issues.rationale: Readers without systems background may not understand why 'guessing in parallel' helps with a memory bandwidth problem. The intuition is that parallel verification amortizes the parameter loading cost across multiple predictions.

issues.problem: Lemmas 3.3 and Theorem 3.5 are cited (line 98) but not proved; readers must accept on faith that the residual normalization constant equals 1-β
issues.suggested_fix: Add a proof sketch: '(Lemma 3.3) The normalization constant is 1-β because ∑_x min(p,q) + ∑_x max(0,p-q) = 1 (every token is either in-agreement or has residual mass).'
issues.rationale: The 1-β normalization is the linchpin of the distribution-preserving proof. Leaving it as an external reference makes this key pivot feel opaque. A one-line sketch would anchor reader confidence.

issues.problem: Code variables hc_mult and hc_head (lines 360, 366) are used but never defined
issues.suggested_fix: Add footnote: 'hc = 'head combination'; these consolidate MTP outputs across parallel heads before passing to the output head.'
issues.rationale: Readers trying to follow the code-to-math mapping cannot understand what these variables do or why they're needed. A one-sentence definition unblocks the implementation understanding.

issues.problem: Autoregressive decoding is introduced metaphorically (line 22: '打字员') but never formally defined
issues.suggested_fix: Add before line 22: 'In standard autoregressive decoding, generating K tokens requires K sequential forward passes: each output depends on all previous tokens, forcing a serial bottleneck.'
issues.rationale: This is the problem statement. Readers who don't already know autoregressive generation will be confused by the premise. A one-sentence definition is necessary for accessibility.

issues.problem: Gumbel-max sampling (line 424) is presented as if standard knowledge without explanation
issues.suggested_fix: Add: 'Adding i.i.d. Gumbel(0,1) noise to log-probabilities then taking argmax is equivalent to sampling from the distribution (a technique called ancestor sampling)—this avoids explicit normalization.'
issues.rationale: Readers unfamiliar with probabilistic algorithms won't recognize why argmax(prob/q) achieves sampling. A sentence explains both the trick and its purpose.

issues.problem: Proposer and proposer factory are referenced (line 390) without definition; assumes reader has read §29
issues.suggested_fix: Add: 'A proposer is a module that generates candidate tokens to be verified; MTP is one proposer architecture. The proposer factory (Chapter 29) selects which proposer to use and schedules verification.'
issues.rationale: Readers may not have read Chapter 29. An inline definition allows this chapter to stand alone while still honoring the reference.
